automaticUpdates.trigger: ordinary task entry; excludes help/version/source/task polling
automaticUpdates.installation: explicit standing authorization; compatible stable version only
automaticUpdates.recovery: update operation and resume reuse verified candidate

generationWorkflow.references: Reuse the fixed initial ordered reference list in every round. Generated outputs are inspection evidence only.
generationWorkflow.nextRound: After visual inspection, revise the complete prompt from observed issues and submit one image within the remaining authorized budget.
generationWorkflow.recovery: Resume the same task after an uncertain outcome. Technical failures do not trigger a new paid round automatically.

installationLifecycle.install: Resolve own directory; skill install --agent AGENT --path EXACT_SKILL_DIR --json
installationLifecycle.update: Resolve selected target first; update install --yes --path EXACT_SKILL_DIR --json
installationLifecycle.verification: Local runtime version, managed hashes, then host-native discovery

legacyFields.edited: boolean retained; use editedFiles for paths

maintenanceContract.evidenceReuse: Reuse matching package/version/target/integrity receipts within the operation; repeat only after mutation, conflict or stale channel evidence.
